v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Exsúrgens María, * ábiit in montána cum festinatióne in civitátem Iuda.
text.en: Mary arose * and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah.

text.la: Intrávit María * in domum Zacharíæ, et salutávit Elísabeth.
text.en: Mary entered * into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elizabeth.

text.la: Ut audívit * salutatiónem Maríæ Elísabeth, exsultávit infans in útero eius, et repléta est Spíritu Sancto, allelúia.
text.en: When Elizabeth heard * the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb, and she was filled with the Holy Ghost. Alleluia.

text.la: Benedícta * tu inter mulíeres, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
text.en: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb.

text.la: Ex quo facta est * vox salutatiónis tuæ in áuribus meis, exsultávit infans in útero meo, allelúia.
text.en: As soon as * the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy. Alleluia.

text.la: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
text.en: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

text.la: Prima stropha sequentis hymni dicitur flexis genibus.
text.en: The first verse of the following hymn is said genuflecting.

r.en: And blessed is the Fruit of thy womb.

text.la: Beátam me dicent * omnes generatiónes, quia ancíllam húmilem respéxit Deus.
text.en: All generations shall call me blessed, * for God hath regarded the lowliness of His hand-maiden.

text.la: Fámulis tuis, quǽsumus, Dómine, cæléstis grátiæ munus impertíre: ut, quibus beátæ Vírginis partus éxstitit salútis exórdium; Visitatiónis eius votíva solémnitas, pacis tríbuat increméntum.
text.en: Grant, O Lord, we beseech thee, unto all thy servants, the gift of thine heavenly grace, that even as the Blessed Virgin being made a Mother hath been unto them the first step unto their salvation, so the godly and solemn memorial of her Visitation may be the bringer of an increase of peace.
